description: Reads a reference video of up to 3 minutes in the library and returns a job whose result is its breakdown: hook, structure, shots, pacing and look, with still frames, and none of its footage, sound or words. Without a quote, returns the cost and makes nothing. A held quote spends a few of the account's credits; rights_confirmed records the person's permission to study the file. Upload the video at https://ugc.fans/library first.

quote.description: The held quote for this exact request, after the person confirms its cost.

rights_confirmed.description: The person confirms they may study this file.
